profile.headline: Software Developer
profile.summary:
BS Computer Science graduate from the University of Texas at Dallas looking for work!

Throughout my education, regardless of the subject, I have always put forth the effort required to learn the material presented. I believe this mentality supports the development of a strong educational foundation which allows for a deeper understanding of specific information. Currently, I wish to soak up every bit of information I can from my work and personal projects.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
• Full-stack and navigation skills for a large monolithic web application repository.
• Maintained coding standards by following established version control, ticketing system, and peer reviews.
• Collaborated with developers and QA to design and implement software solutions.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
• Collaborated in team of 3 to develop ClearSite, improving streamlining semiconductor endpoint detection.
• Translated Figma designs into desktop application using Flutter, Dart, and Redux.
• Developed custom graphing component with cursor tracking, zooming, panning, equations, graph markers, and regions for data analysis.
• Developed Trend Definition Page, featuring Trend list and Trend Modifier for interacting/modifying graph
equations.
• Developed Sequence Builder Page, including sequence building with dynamic validation on user graph interaction.
• Developed Endpoint Tester Page, implementing custom Table, Run Chart, and Histogram for analyzing sequences across multiple files.

positions.title: Full Stack Developer
positions.description:
• Developed web pages using React for the corporate application “Pearl Care”.
• Created front-end page improving process of editing database columns for the support team.
• Improved data retrieval and manipulation through API integration.
• Agile collaboration with front-end developers for seamless feature integrations.

positions.title: Paint Associate
positions.description:
• Detail-oriented in managing paint supplies, maintaining cleanliness, and creating appealing displays.
• Experienced verbal communication in selling various paint types, including primers, sealers, and stains.
• Proficient communication for matching paint colors to customer preferences.
positions.insights: Communication, Customer Relationship Management (CRM) and +3 skills
